name: Dakota Metal Fabrication Inc
old_description: If you're looking for a metal fabrication specialist, Dakota Metal Fabrication is the company to call. We've been providing exceptional metal fabrication services at affordable prices since 2007. When you choose us, you'll get the service you deserve in a timely manner.
about:
Dakota Metal Fabrication was established in 2007 in Manvel, North Dakota. The locally owned, privately held S corporation is 60 percent woman-owned and operates a union shop with 30 full-time employees. A branch office serves customers from Fargo.

The company provides metal fabrication, welding, and HVAC services from its Manvel facility. Capabilities include sheet metal fabrication, stainless steel welding, custom one-of-a-kind fabrication, and production runs of metal items. The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, and copper, and also fabricates food processing equipment.

Customers span commercial HVAC, industrial ventilation, and the broader sheet metal, heating, and air-conditioning sectors. The firm serves both custom and production needs for food processing equipment and other industrial metalwork.

The company emphasizes affordable pricing, timely delivery, and certified professionals who aim to get the job done right the first time, backed by over 94 years of combined industry experience among its staff.
